title: Chocolate Banana Recovery Smoothie
seoTitle: Chocolate Banana Recovery Smoothie | Firefighter Smoothie
subtitle: Recovery · Recovery
description: Tastes like a treat, behaves like recovery food. Cocoa and banana do the heavy lifting — no syrup, no ice cream required.
intro: Tastes like a treat, behaves like recovery food. Cocoa and banana do the heavy lifting — no syrup, no ice cream required.

steps.instruction: Blend banana, cocoa, milk, yogurt, nut butter, and salt until the color is uniform chocolate brown.
Scrape the sides and blend again — cocoa can cling to the jar.
Texture should be thick and shake-like. Thin with milk 2 tbsp at a time if needed.
Serve right away for best flavor; salt is small but makes the chocolate taste deeper.

nutrition.highlights: ~320 cal · ~18 g protein · potassium · satisfies sweet cravings without bakery sugar levels

substitutions: Chocolate protein powder (1 scoop) replaces cocoa + some yogurt.
Dairy-free milk and yogurt alternatives work fine.
shiftNote: This one works well after workouts or overnight calls because it is higher in protein but still light.
